items.description:
A message returned through the generalized conversation endpoints.
The existing family-only `/api/chat/groups/...` endpoints continue to
return the legacy `ChatMessage` schema instead.

kind.description: An open persisted discriminator; current messages use `USER` or `SYSTEM_MILESTONE`.

content.description:
Plaintext content. Current servers send plaintext only; for an
unsupported encryption marker clients must not infer or display
this field.

attachmentUrl.description: A participant- or family-scoped `/uploads/...` path, or null.

replyToMessageId.description: Present for FAMILY responses; omitted for PRIVATE responses.

replyTo.description: Read-time reply preview, present for FAMILY responses.

readBy.description:
Family members whose read position is at or after the message;
present for FAMILY responses and omitted for PRIVATE responses.

encryption.description:
Open compatibility marker for future conversation payload formats.
`none` is the only marker supported by today's clients. This
schema is forward compatibility, not a claim that direct-message
encryption is shipped.

encryptedPayload.description:
Opaque encrypted payload reserved for a future client/server
format. For current plaintext messages it is null. A client that
does not recognize `encryption` must render a generic
unsupported-message placeholder and must not derive a preview,
attachment indicator, or content from `encryptedPayload`.

items.title: ChatConversationMessage

nextCursor.description: Pass back as `?cursor=` for the next page; `null` on the last page.
